name: Sentrial
long_description:
Sentrial is the monitoring platform for AI products in production. 

When your AI product/agent loops indefinitely, hallucinates, or frustrates users, Sentrial detects it in real-time, diagnoses the root cause, and recommends specific fixes. We provide the monitoring, evaluation, and debugging infrastructure that traditional tools weren't built for, so teams iterate based on production reality, not just offline evals.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Neel is the founder of Sentrial - production monitoring for AI products. 

He studied Computer Science at UC Berkeley and worked on agentic optimization at Sense. He saw firsthand that traditional evaluation frameworks break down once agents hit production. That insight led to the creation of Sentrial, a platform built to monitor, evaluate, and improve agent performance in real-world, production environments.

contact: neel@sentrial.com

launches.title: Sentrial: Production Monitoring for AI Agent Behavior
launches.tagline: Sentrial helps engineering teams detect, diagnose, and fix AI agent issues in production.
launches.body:
Hi all! [Neel](http://linkedin.com/in/neelshar) and [Anay](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anayrshukla/) here - we’re building **Sentrial**, production monitoring for AI agent behavior.

**TL;DR:** [Sentrial](https://sentrial.com) semantically detects when agents loop, hallucinate, misuse tools, or frustrate users in production, then helps engineering teams diagnose the root cause and fix it fast.

[Sentrial Launch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fiRRBG9NIE4)

## The problem

AI agents are becoming core infrastructure - handling customer support, automating workflows, and making decisions on behalf of users. But when something goes wrong, teams are flying blind. Traditional monitoring catches errors and latency, not failures like hallucinations or user frustration. No alert fires when an agent goes off the rails, and agents that were meant to scale operations end up requiring constant oversight.

## What Sentrial does

Sentrial gives engineering teams real-time visibility into how their agents actually behave in production. We automatically detect failure patterns: loops, hallucinations, tool misuse, and user frustrations the moment they happen. When issues surface, Sentrial diagnoses the root cause by analyzing conversation patterns, model outputs, and tool interactions, then recommends specific fixes.

## Ask

If your internal or customer-facing agents are looping, hallucinating, or frustrating users in production and it’s hard to diagnose, we’d love to talk. Email [neel@sentrial.com](mailto:neel@sentrial.com) or book a call [here](https://cal.com/neel-sharma) to learn more!

## Team

**Neel:** CS @ UC Berkeley, worked on Agentic Optimization at Sense.\
**Anay:** CS @ UC Berkeley, deployed DevOps agents at Accenture.
